data.long_meaning: Haasyim is an Arabic name derived from the root word 'hasana' which means 'to be good' or 'to be beneficial'. This name is often given to a child who is considered a blessing and a reward, as if the child is a gift from Allah. The name Haasyim carries the meaning “Gift, reward” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Haasyim usually hope their child will grow to embody gift, reward and live with faith, good character and purpose.
